cap8_start: CAPUT OCTAVUM / Demonstratur resurrectionem carnis a nonnullis negari
cap9_start: mid PHYS 388 CAPUT NONUM / Resurrectionem mortuorum possibilem esse
titles: CHAPTER EIGHT. Some who acknowledge Scripture wrongly deny the resurrection of the flesh; better assert it
I. Sadducees; Hymenaeus and Philetus — spiritual-only or succession-by-procreation readings
II–IV. Other ancient deniers — Carpocrates, Valentinians, Gnostics; Tertullian on partiarii of the Sadducees
Early heretics from Simon Magus onward; Philoponus; V. nearly all prior-century heretics denied flesh-resurrection
IV recent. Fewer openly deny; Amalric of Paris; Pope John XXIII; Libertines per Calvin
Libertine spiritualizing; Photinians, Weigelians, Rosicrucians, Paracelsian chemists recook Valentinus
Feuardentius insults Farel; Farel meant humanly impossible, not simply impossible; Rivetus on the letter — Cap. 8 close
notes: Liber II Cap. 8 densify COMPLETE. Next mid PHYS 388 CAPUT NONUM / Resurrectionem mortuorum possibilem esse. No Punch X / ship / ai_promote / mixed commit.
